faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Railway Recruitment Cell, Eastern Railway (RRC Eastern Railway) for filling up cultural quota positions in West Bengal.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in RRC Eastern Railway Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for Group 'C' posts under the Cultural Quota for the year 2026-27.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for RRC Eastern Railway Group 'C' posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 12th with 50% marks or 10th plus ITI/NAC, along with a Degree, Diploma, or Certificate in the respective cultural discipline from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 30 years as on 01.01.2027. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories such as SC, ST, and OBC as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What are the starting and closing dates for online applications?
faq.answer: The online application window opens on 09-10-2026 and closes on 08-11-2026. Candidates must submit their applications before the final deadline.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for UR and male candidates?
faq.answer: UR, OBC, and EWS male candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 500/-, out of which Rs. 400/- is refundable upon appearing in the written exam.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee concession for female and reserved category candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, women, SC, ST, Ex-servicemen, PwBD, minorities, and economically backward classes pay Rs. 250/-, which is fully refundable upon appearing in the written exam.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary structure for RRC Eastern Railway Group 'C' Cultural Quota?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed in Level-2 of the Pay Matrix of the 7th CPC with a Grade Pay of Rs. 1900/-.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Written Test (Stage-I) followed by an assessment of talent through practical demonstration and testimonials (Stage-II), and a Medical Examination.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply for this job opening?
faq.answer: Eligible and interested candidates can apply online by visiting the official website of RRC Eastern Railway at www.rrcer.org or using the direct apply link.
